info.best_time_val: Clear days for views; winter for snow

overview.title: The high balcony above town
overview.p1: Michlifen sits higher than Ifrane: offering winter sports when snow arrives, and sweeping views the rest of the year. Just a short drive up from town.
overview.p2: In winter, check road and skiing conditions before heading up. Off-season, treat it as a scenic viewpoint for fresh mountain air.

moods.title: Michlifen throughout the day
moods.subtitle: Altitude, wind, and visibility shape your visit.

1.title: Crisp morning views
1.desc: Best chance for clear, long-distance visibility.

2.title: Bright and exposed
2.desc: Strong sun and wind — protect your skin and eyes.

3.title: Late afternoon light
3.desc: Dramatic colors if the clouds stay high.

food.title: Eating near Michlifen
food.p1: Food options are limited and mostly seasonal. Have a full meal in Ifrane if you want a proper menu.
food.p2: Bring water and snacks in all seasons — it is higher and more exposed than the town below.
food.li2: Seasonal cafés when open in winter.
food.li3: Dinner in town after enjoying the view.
food.li5: Do not count on a full-service restaurant at the pass.

1.title: The road
1.desc: Can be icy or closed in winter — check conditions before driving.

2.title: Clothing
2.desc: Colder than the plains; pack gloves and a warm layer in winter.

3.title: Expectations
3.desc: A small ski station by Alpine standards — go primarily for the scenery.

q1.question: Can you ski every winter?
q1.answer: Only when there is enough snow and facilities are running — seasons vary.

q2.question: Is it worth visiting without snow?
q2.answer: Yes, for the sweeping views and crisp mountain air.

q3.question: How far is it from Ifrane?
q3.answer: A short uphill drive from town.

q4.question: Is it family-friendly?
q4.answer: Yes, just take care when the ground is icy.

q5.question: Do I need a guide?
q5.answer: No, not for a scenic viewpoint stop.
